user.title: Select iHanoi cameras
user.description: Choose which cameras to add to Home Assistant. You can add/remove cameras later from this integration's Options.

data_description.update_interval_minutes: The camera list's wss_url session tokens expire; set to 0 to disable auto-refresh and rely only on the 'Update Camera List' button.

quality.title: JPEG compression quality
quality.description:
Set the JPEG compression quality (30-100%, higher = sharper but larger) for each selected camera. Applies to both the full-size snapshot and the 640x360 preview image.
{camera_list}

error.no_cameras_selected: Please select at least one camera.
error.invalid_update_interval: Update interval must be a non-negative whole number of minutes.
error.invalid_jpeg_quality: JPEG quality must be a whole number between 30 and 100.
